SAX Design System

Design tokens, end to end — @sax/design-system v1.0.2

DTCG 2025.10 OKLCH APCA

One source of truth

  • Tokens are DTCG 2025.10 JSON — tools come and go, the format stays
  • Three tiers: component → semantic → primitive
  • Overrides only remap references — a primitive change propagates everywhere

Perceptual color

Palettes are OKLCH tonal ramps; step = lightness × 100.

This deck is in your OS mode right now — every color is a light-dark() pair.

Contrast is a build gate

Success: Lc 67.0 ≥ 60 — alert text on status background
Warning: every pair here passed APCA before this deck could build
Danger: a failing pair fails npm run build

APCA Readability Criterion: Lc 75 body · 60 labels · 45 non-text

APCA gates

RoleMin LcApplies to
Body75Paragraphs, input values
Labels60Headings, buttons, captions
Non-text45Focus rings, indicators

Every pairing in config/contrast-pairs.json, checked per situation × mode.

The pipeline

npm run build
  1 generate:resolvers   situation x mode matrix -> 12 resolvers
  2 validate             ajv vs official DTCG schemas
  3 check:color          hex sync + APCA gates
  4 build:tokens         one stylesheet: base + situation deltas
  5-9 previews           base.css, catalogs, samples, this deck

Consume a token

// Read a semantic token's computed value at runtime
function tokenValue(name) {
  const styles = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
  return styles.getPropertyValue(`--${name}`).trim();
}

const accent = tokenValue('color-accent-default'); // a light-dark() pair
console.log(`accent = ${accent}`, 0xff);

Syntax colors are tokens too — light-dark(), APCA-gated on the code background.

Products pin a version

A token release is a contract: rename or remove a token and it is a breaking change.
